purpose: Screen the retained prompt-cache entry-count trade-off on the frozen iteration16 navigation workload, preserving quality, useful-work timing and resource uncertainty.

single_changed_factor.byte_flag_limit: The installed seeded sequential serving path does not enforce this byte flag; it must not be described as a 256 MiB allocation cap. The entry-count limit is the tested control.

denominator_rule: All declared arms/captures/turns remain in every applicable outcome inventory. Failed, unrun, timed-out, missing or interrupted observations are explicit rows with reasons and null timings when unavailable; no replacement trials, success-only comparison, retry/exclusion or invented observation. Additional actual calls, transcripts, effects, parser/repair/fallback work and packets remain included even beyond planned counts.
controls: Freeze the completed iteration16 production source, configuration and recorder bytes for all three arms. Inherit its exact case expectations, speech criteria, trigger rules and deadlines; do not edit historical artifacts.

Use fresh output directories, fresh LLM/agent/LiveKit processes and fresh rooms per arm. Reuse model bytes/revisions, synthetic WAV bytes, seed 7, decoding options, prefill step size 256, max_tokens 500, STT/TTS/VAD settings and unchanged STT/AEC instrumentation. Do not add runtime observers in one arm only.

Use the same separate preflight method before every arm, verifying complete source/model/input receipts and required free ports. Record actual full launch argv and process identities in each arm, and independently verify only prompt-cache-size differs among semantic LLM settings.
Keep initial load/warmup and the first fresh-process request in recorded outcomes. Fresh processes do not reset OS/file caches, system swap, unrelated background load or thermal state.

Run all three timed arms sequentially before any received-audio ASR. After each arm preserve room departure and bounded owned-process cleanup receipts; verify owned services/clients absent before the next arm. Do not kill external processes or delete rooms to conceal cleanup failures.

No tests, downloads, model changes or extra inference during timed arms. Whole-stream ASR runs only after all timed services have exited, under the unchanged pinned review method. Review each available declared whole stream once, without trimming or retries; missing streams remain failed/unmeasured cases.

Frozen prompt templates/settings and input WAVs do not prove byte-identical adaptive requests: differing outputs, transcripts, history, slots, tool results, parser retries and semantic repairs can change later prompts and physical requests. Retain available raw planner/responder receipts and distinguish parsed plans, logical invocations and actual server requests; mark unavailable request counts/equality explicitly.

required_quality_checks.inputs_and_effects: Per arm retain all10 finalized transcripts against exact declared text, every attempted/reused call and all10 expected navigation effects. Preserve allowed-plan checks separately from semantic effects. Both return cases must activate airport→office→airport through distinct fresh routes; both cancellations must clear the route.
required_quality_checks.interruptions: Require all6 declared preceding result handles interrupted per arm using distinct newly finalized turn/result triggers. Report observed PCM tails and handle interruption separately; neither proves physical audible stop.
required_quality_checks.final_speech: Per arm all4 final replies must finish and satisfy unchanged predeclared facts: cancellation confirms airport navigation cancelled, with no-active backend state checked separately; return confirms active airport navigation replacing office and88-minute estimate. Intentionally interrupted earlier replies need not be complete in whole-stream ASR. Preserve every proper-name/numeric deviation.
required_quality_checks.trace_and_runtime: Independently report full trusted client/server trace equality for all12 captures, identity-missing/untrusted packets, raw decoded comparison, tool errors, stale/unknown/pending effects, warnings, native observer health and server job statuses. Never relabel prior or new failures successful because effects or ASR pass. Raw decoded equality cannot authenticate sender identity.
required_quality_checks.physical_calls: Reference18–26 physical attempts per arm is inherited from declared allowed plans, not a license to truncate. Count every physical attempt/reuse/status; record plan changes and repair/fallback work, including attempts outside the reference range as failures/deviations. Request counts can legitimately vary with adaptive planning.

metrics.summary_method: Nearest-rank p50/p95 = sorted available values[ceil(n*p)-1], accompanied by full declared n, observed n, failed/unmeasured count, every raw value and arm/case/turn identity. Preserve cold first observations. No significance tests or pooled population claim.
metrics.grouping: Primary summaries are separate A2_first, B1 and A2_return arms, with initial4/followup6/all10 turn groups and cancellation2/return2/all4 case groups. Show A-to-A drift and B versus each A; do not merge both baselines into8 independent replicates or pool all30 turns to hide arm differences. Any pooled table is descriptive with dependence labels.
receipt_latency: Scheduled RMS-threshold input speech end → finalized transcript, acknowledgment text/PCM, first tool intention, mutation intention/success, substantive result text/PCM and result-handle finish. State all clock/receipt boundaries; intention is not backend entry and PCM receipt is not physical playback.
Mutation success → result text/PCM, and preceding result PCM tail/handle interruption relative to each followup onset. Interrupted result finish stays null.

fulfilled_case_completion.start: Final input scheduled speech end, not the first input of the conversation.
fulfilled_case_completion.end: Client observation of final result handle finished.
required_gate: Every declared backend effect for the full case succeeded.
All final reply facts passed the whole-stream review.
Final result handle finished and its elapsed observation exists.
fulfilled_case_completion.failure: Retain null fulfilled time and specific failure reasons for any unmet condition, beside observed-but-unfulfilled finish time. The full12case denominator always remains. Trace equality/cleanup remain distinct mandatory reported outcomes rather than being silently folded into this metric.

stt.all_call_inventory: Retain every outer request and native call, including warmup, cancellation, errors, pending/late completion and extra recognitions. Expected30recognitions+3warmups is a declared target, not a filtered count. Report dropped records/bytes and missing endpoints.
timings: Engine API entry→submit; submit→worker entry; worker entry→native completion; native completion→caller return; full API→caller.
Original model load/check, tempfile/WAV operations, model.transcribe, Parakeet load_audio, get_logmel and generate host-call boundaries. Preserve nesting and do not sum parent with children.
stt.pcm_identity: Hash and retain exact16k mono int16 submitted and WAV-write PCM payloads, bytes, sample rate and equality per call. Equal source WAVs or rounded durations do not imply identical endpointed PCM.
stt.matched_subset: Alongside all-call summaries, report cross-arm exact submitted-PCM SHA256+byte-count+sample-rate matches for the same declared case/turn role, excluding warmup from recognition comparisons. List all occurrences and unmatched rows. No matching subset is reported as n=0, not fabricated equivalence; matched rows remain dependent and are not substitute full-denominator results.
stt.interpretation: No added accelerator synchronization. Queue includes dispatch/instrumentation/scheduling; generate may include lazy compute, synchronization and memory movement. Timing is not GPU-exclusive. Report observer measured hooks/cost and its incomplete overhead boundary.

metrics.llm_cache_prefill: Retain every server-reported cache entry count/logical byte value, remaining prompt/prefill token count and available prefill/decode timing with request order. Count whether candidate ever exceeds one retained entry at observation points. Distinguish logged logical cache bytes from allocated/resident memory and incomplete logging from a zero value. Added prefill, parser/repair/fallback work and generated-token counts must remain visible; absent telemetry is explicitly unavailable.
metrics.memory: Use the same sampler/cadence in all arms. Report whole-system available-memory and swap start/end/min/max, within-arm deltas, sample counts/errors, and owned stack parents/descendants RSS with declared exclusions (separate recorder client excluded by inherited sampler). RSS is not total unified allocation and sums can double-count shared pages. Align sampled memory rows to each slow STT/request window by same-host monotonic clocks; disclose sampling gaps/peaks missed. Swap levels/deltas are not per-process paging or causation.
metrics.provenance_cleanup: Preserve arm source/model/input hashes before/after, launch commands/PIDs, readiness failures, room departure, trace flush, worker exit/escalation, SDK job status and final owned-PID absence. Retain all failures even if useful work completed.

decision_rule.classification: Exploratory screen only; no production/default cache change is authorized by this protocol or justified by a single middle arm.
decision_rule.invalid_or_inconclusive: Factor/source/model/input/preflight violations, missing required arm evidence or unresolved owned-process cleanup make the comparison invalid/inconclusive. Retain all12declared outcome rows rather than rerun/select replacements.
decision_rule.quality_gate: Any B1 failure in declared transcripts, effects, interruption or final-speech facts disqualifies a favorable quality-preserving screen label. Report analogous A failures and all trace/runtime failures explicitly; source/attribution uncertainty cannot be traded away for memory or latency.
decision_rule.promising_for_replication_only: Require intended one-entry behavior and lower observed peak logical retained-cache bytes than each A arm, complete B1 quality, and fulfilled-case reply p50 and p95 no worse than either A arm with all4cases measured. Show all per-case costs and A-to-A drift. This label supports another controlled replication, not adoption, statistical superiority or a claim of actual memory savings.
decision_rule.tradeoff_or_unfavorable: If lower logical retention comes with slower fulfilled replies, label the observed trade-off and retain two entries pending stronger evidence. Added prefill remains a disclosed useful-work cost even when measured replies are not slower and the promising-for-replication criteria hold. System-memory or RSS differences alone cannot establish allocation savings or outweigh a demonstrated latency/quality regression. Conflicting/weak memory evidence remains ambiguous, not a measured benefit.
decision_rule.interpretation: Assess useful-work quality and completion latency before isolated resource numbers. Any future adoption needs independently replicated evidence that the memory benefit is real and worth prefill/latency cost; this fixed A/B/A order with only one B process cannot establish that causal conclusion.

limits: Twelve serial captures share three process lifetimes and one machine; they are not twelve independent hardware replicates. Fixed order, warm file caches, unrelated applications, preexisting swap and thermal drift remain confounders.

The same synthetic development cases informed the production fix. This is not held-out evaluation, broad language fidelity, concurrent-room capacity, human microphone/echo testing or physical acoustic timing.
All timing/reporting comparisons are descriptive. Frozen settings do not establish identical adaptive prompts or PCM segments, and different useful work is not silently normalized away.
The selected cache entry control does not cap total LLM/STT/TTS/system memory. No new MLX limits, quantization, seed removal, batching, prefill-size changes or model changes belong in this screen.
